The number is entry 44 of 64 and the subject block, taken in order, has 64 entries, so the aligned subject is entry 44 at offsets 14053-14120: 'Creating an emergency board to investigate an airline labor dispute'. That subject agrees with the target's own held title (a Railway Labor Act emergency board). The number lies between the enacting sentence (691-966) and the editorial note/signature block (32923), is a standalone line that occurs once in the held file, and the page holds no neighbouring document. The alignment of number to subject is by order, not by a printed row, so the reviewer should confirm it. The provision also reaches 'any amendments thereto' (recorded here; not a separate target).
